messages:
Priya (SRE): FYI: scheduling a cross-region failover drill Thursday 2026-06-10 01:00-01:30 UTC. Target: validate inter-region routing, controlplane failover, and stateful cache rehydration. Expect increased latencies for affected customer routes and possible 5xx spikes for <5 minutes during cutover.

Priya (SRE): Goals: 1) Promote standby controlplane in eu-west-1 -> primary for 10m, 2) verify smart routing to nearest healthy region, 3) confirm KV cache warmup and sticky-session continuity, 4) exercise rollback to original primary.

oncall-bot: Maintenance window created: 2026-06-10 01:00-01:30 UTC. Pager rotations adjusted. See tags: sim_failover_1887654321.

Diego (network): What's the exact command to promote standby? I want to prepare BGP/route filters so we don't flap external gateways.

Priya (SRE): Controlplane CLI:
```
redwoodctl controlplane promote --region eu-west-1 --duration 600 --reason "cross-region-failover-drill-1887654321"
```
We'll also set `--announce=false` for a dry internal failover first, then flip announce=true at 01:05 to exercise external routing.

Sam (platform): We'll disable auto-canary and stop automatic model rollouts for 00:30-02:00 UTC. Also toggling traffic tags so production traffic is excluded from model-variant cost-tiering. Test traffic will carry `x-sim: failover-drill`.

Jesse (eng): Suggestion: enable prefer-quantized fallback for non-prod to conserve GPU cycles during the drill. Also will spin up a synthetic customer that asserts deterministic outputs to validate functional equivalence.

Priya (SRE): Agreed: `cost-tier: prefer-quantized` for test traffic only. Production routes remain pinned to full-fidelity models.

Sam (platform): SLO adjustments planned: increase alert thresholds during window to reduce noisy pages: p99 latency -> 2.5s, error rate alert -> 3%. Will annotate all alerts with `suppress:1887654321` and auto-revert at 01:45.

Diego (network): I've scheduled route-gateway watchers and will mute BGP flaps alerts for the specific prefixes. Will post dashboard link in thread before 00:50.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please run the preflight checklist 30m before the window. Checklist link: https://wiki.redwood.internal/sre/failover-drill-preflight.

Priya (SRE): Preflight highlights: - Confirm backup controlplane health >= 3/3 - KV-store replication lag < 250ms - Cache priming job ready - Escalation contacts up to date

Jesse (eng): Cache priming helper (example):
```
# priming parallelized
xargs -P 40 -n 1 -I {} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $PRIME_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"{}"}' < top_1000_prefixes.txt
```
We'll tag priming requests with `x-sim: failover-drill`.

Priya (SRE): During the flip, expected customer visible effects: short latency bump, some routed requests hitting standby and being slower until caches warm, possible 502s for <3 minutes in worst-case. If we see >10% 5xx for >5m, escalate immediately to #outage.

Sam (platform): I'm adding a temporary dashboard panel: controlplane_promote_time, interregion_latency, kv_cache_hit_ratio, model_variant_fallback_rate. Link will be in this thread by 00:55.

Diego (network): Quick ask: any objections to also running a controlled DNS TTL drop to 60s for the test prefixes so client-side failover is exercised?

Priya (SRE): OK for test prefixes only. Keep production DNS TTLs unchanged. Ensure CDNs are excluded.

deploy-bot: Canary rollouts suspended for window 2026-06-10 00:30-02:00 UTC per Sam.

oncall-bot: If an unexpected outage is detected, tag with incident.sim.failover.1887654321 for easy log filtering.

Priya (SRE): Post-drill debrief scheduled 2026-06-10 02:00 UTC in #eng-sre. Please add any runbook gaps to the doc: https://wiki.redwood.internal/sre/cross-region-failover-runbook.

Jesse (eng): Will capture priming stdout and a short summary and drop into this thread after the drill.

Sam (platform): Acknowledged. I'll post the alert suppression window and dashboard link.

Diego (network): Acknowledged. I'll also coordinate with infra on any external peering ops we might need.

Priya (SRE): Thanks team. Aim: validate our cross-region resilience with minimal customer impact & actionable postmortem notes. Keep chatter light during drill and use short pings only.

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance reminder will fire 15m and 5m before window.
